# /omarchy-eval:omarchy-pr-check

Evaluate an omacom/omarchy PR with charly checks on disposable beds.
The checks assert the resulting SYSTEM STATE (charly consequence
checks), not upstream's mocked call sequences — strictly stronger.

## The beds

- `check-omarchy-suite-pod` — Tier-1 pod: the omarchy base + the
  migration-outcome checks (retired-installer sudoers artifact absent,
  no legacy power udev rules, fido2 opt-in absent). Build context.
- `check-omarchy-suite-pod-pr9343` — Tier-1 PR injection: the PR's
  files applied at BUILD time via a per-PR candy (candy run steps
  emit as Containerfile RUN, as root); the declarative check asserts
  the PR's behavior (e.g. omarchy-migrate --pending exits 2 with the
  message when the migrations dir is absent).
- `check-omarchy-pr-vm` — Tier-2 VM PR injection: the shipped
  omarchy-vm template + the PR candy via add_candy (deploy time).
- `check-omarchy-pr-vm-visual` — Tier-2 visual evidence loop: the
  desktop + a wl: screenshot capture + an agent-check step grading
  the visual against the visual-verification.md rubric (ADE).
- `check-omarchy-hybrid-gpu-vm` — L3 dual-GPU hybrid bed: the
  virtio iGPU video beside a passed-through NVIDIA dGPU in ONE bed.
  The host is pre-flipped (`charly vm gpu mode vfio`); the deploy
  declares `requires_exclusive: [nvidia-gpu]` and `charly vm create`
  auto-allocates the whole-IOMMU-group hostdev. The in-guest
  `bin/omarchy-hw-hybrid-gpu` detection must be TRUE and a full
  switch cycle (bind/unbind, PCI runtime PM, compositor restart)
  must complete.

## VFIO GPU passthrough (L3 hybrid lane)

- Host readiness: `charly vm gpu status` (IOMMU on, card bound to
  vfio-pci) — host `nvidia-smi` FAILS BY DESIGN on a passthrough-ready
  host (the card is bound to vfio-pci so a guest can claim it).
- The hostdev is AUTO-ALLOCATED: a deploy declaring
  `requires_exclusive: [nvidia-gpu]` + the embedded `resource:`
  vocabulary (`nvidia-gpu: {resource: {gpu: {vendor: "0x10de"}}}` in
  charly/charly.yml) makes `charly vm create` detect the matching
  GPU, write its whole-IOMMU-group `hostdevs:` block into the
  per-domain instance.yml, and inject it — or FAIL HARD if absent.
- The entity needs `backend: libvirt` + `firmware: uefi-insecure`
  (PCI <hostdev> renders only on libvirt; UEFI is mandatory for a
  modern GPU 64-bit large BAR).
- The in-guest driver: the `layer-nvidia` kernel layer (blacklists
  the in-tree driver, regenerates the initramfs, reboots the guest).
- The arbiter flips the GPU mode automatically (vfio for
  requires_exclusive, nvidia for requires_shared); `charly vm gpu
  mode [vfio|nvidia]` is the manual override.

## The procedure

1. Load the rubric: omarchy's agents/skills (acceptance-tests,
   visual-verification, migrations, shell-dev, install-scripts,
   command-metadata, icon-font, hyprland, capture) — vendored and
   pinned at a quattro hash so evaluation criteria are version-locked.
2. Tier 0: classify the diff (the venue ladder) and assign a venue;
   extract the PR's "## Verification" claim; hardware-bound classes
   get PARTIAL/NOT-EVALUABLE, never a faked bed.
3. Tier 1: `charly check run check-omarchy-suite-pod` (or the
   PR-variant bed) — the suite pod's charly checks.
4. Tier 2 (by class): `charly check run check-omarchy-pr-vm` /
   `check-omarchy-pr-vm-visual` — the VM PR injection + visual
   evidence loop.
5. Evidence contract: the check-run summary.yml + the screenshot
   artifact + the ADE verdict (charly check feature run --agent).
6. Render the validation comment from the results; POST only
   behind the operator approval gate.
7. Batch loop: repeated bed runs, one per PR, with the SHA-keyed
   result cache (scripts/omarchy-rollup.py) skipping unchanged heads.

## Guardrails (from doctrine)

- Never let an ADE/iteration loop rewrite widget QML wholesale
  (shell-dev.md glyph loss).
- Migrations double-run (the S5 harness proves idempotence).
- Assert the SERVES not the RUNS (quickshell: ping reads responses;
  a supervisor uptime can pass on a wait wrapper).
- PR-body claims are claims, not facts.

## When to Use This Skill

**MUST be invoked** when evaluating an omacom/omarchy PR, running the
omarchy evaluation beds, or grading omarchy visual changes.
